decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage, with a key win condition being to assemble the combo of Lotus Field and Thespian's Stage to generate a large amount of mana quickly. Teferi, Hero of Dominaria provides additional card advantage and control elements, while Dream Trawler acts as a powerful finisher. The deck also includes a variety of utility lands and disruption spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own win condition.

This UW Control deck focuses on card advantage, removal, and countering opponent's spells to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to stall the game with counterspells and board wipes like Supreme Verdict, while generating card advantage with cards like Dig Through Time and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The inclusion of the Companion Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value through blinking permanents. The deck also includes win conditions such as Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants to close out the game once it has gained control.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board of spirits and leveraging tempo plays to disrupt the opponent while dealing consistent damage. It utilizes cards like Rattlechains, Mausoleum Wanderer, and Spectral Sailor to quickly put pressure on the opponent, backed up by cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist to disrupt their game plan. Curious Obsession provides card advantage and helps to keep the aggression going. With a strong manabase and a mix of evasive creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in the early game to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells, removal, and card draw. The goal is to use cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Dovin's Veto, and Supreme Verdict to maintain control while setting up win conditions such as Shark Typhoon and Memory Deluge. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by flickering permanents for more advantage. The deck also includes land destruction with Field of Ruin and tempo plays like Jwari Disruption to keep the opponent off balance.

The deck focuses on utilizing tempo strategies with Azorius Spirits to control the game and maintain a fast-paced aggressive approach. By using Mausoleum Wanderer, Spell Queller, and Shacklegeist, the deck can disrupt opponent's plays while putting pressure with evasive threats like Supreme Phantom and Spectral Sailor. Curious Obsession helps to draw cards and maintain card advantage, while Hengegate Pathway and Geistlight Snare provide additional utility and control options. The inclusion of Slip Out the Back and Invasion of Gobakhan give the deck flexibility and surprise potential to outmaneuver opponents.

This deck focuses on aggressively ramping up green mana and utilizing devotion to green to power up creatures and generate additional resources. The deck includes cards that help accelerate mana production, such as Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, as well as powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator helps generate card advantage and provide additional threats on the board. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly building a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with powerful green creatures.

This aggressive Pioneer deck focuses on utilizing cards that deal direct damage to the opponent while also applying pressure with efficient creatures. By having Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion, the deck benefits from increased damage output. With cards like Soul-Scar Mage, Goblin Chainwhirler, and Bonecrusher Giant, the deck aims to control the board while chipping away at the opponent's life total. With a mix of burn spells and creatures, this deck is designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling key combo pieces to generate powerful synergies and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Metamorphic Alteration and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the player can create strong board presence and gain advantage through clever deck manipulation. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push helps to control the game while the Archfiend Alteration combo pieces come together. Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God acts as a versatile finisher, providing additional value and control options. Ultimately, the goal is to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through strategic planning and execution.

The Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. Using cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, along with efficient mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of powerful threats like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Migloz, Maze Crusher helps maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also utilizes versatile cards like The Akroan War and Invasion of Ixalan to disrupt the opponent's game plan and keep the pressure on.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and control on the battlefield. It focuses on using counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Notion Thief to slow down the opponent's game plan. Narset, Parter of Veils is used to limit the opponent's draw power, while cards like Day's Undoing and Dig Through Time provide card advantage for the player. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent through strategic plays and resource management.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by countering key spells with cards like Dovin's Veto and Spell Pierce, while also removing threats with cards like Supreme Verdict and Portable Hole. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria for card advantage and protection, as well as win conditions like Elspeth, Sun's Champion. The inclusion of Shark Typhoon provides a flexible win condition. The deck's strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and controlling the game until a favorable position is achieved.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures that can quickly build up a powerful board presence. By utilizing low-cost creatures and disruption spells, the deck aims to apply continuous pressure on the opponent while also protecting its own creatures. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant provide additional disruption and buffs, while Castle Ardenvale and Mutavault offer versatility and late-game reach. The goal is to maintain aggression and tempo throughout the game, forcing the opponent to constantly respond to threats.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester to trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil and Claim the Firstborn, while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. It also utilizes the powerful companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for extra mana ramp and consistency. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and maintain control of the board through sacrificing and stealing creatures. Overall, it is an aggressive and flexible deck that can quickly overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on ramping up Mana quickly using green Devotion cards and mana dorks to cast powerful green creatures and spells as early as possible. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to apply pressure while also generating value. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provides additional utility and card advantage, allowing the deck to maintain its tempo and push for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of low-cost creatures, using cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Brave the Elements to buff them and protect them from removal spells. Mutavault and Shefet Dunes provide additional creature support, while Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts opponents' plans with her taxing ability. The deck also includes utility cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Containment Priest to protect key creatures and disrupt opponent's strategies. Castle Ardenvale and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire provide additional sources of mana and protection, making this deck fast and resilient.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells, board wipes, and protecting our own win conditions. The deck aims to stall the game with cards like Strict Proctor and Discontinuity until we can establish our own threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Dream Trawler. The deck also utilizes lands like Lotus Field and Hallowed Fountain to generate mana advantage and cast powerful spells like Finale of Revelation. By controlling the pace of the game and out-valuing the opponent, we can secure victory with our powerful finishers.
